notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Coming to Steam Summer 2020
notes.content:
ChronoBreach Ultra is the full version of ChronoBreach coming Summer 2020!

[b]Wishlist Now on Steam![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297800/ChronoBreach_Ultra/

[u]New Features:[/u]
[list][*] [b]Greater challenge:[/b] fight through enemy encounters that force you to think quickly, bend time to your will, and come up with inventive solutions
[*] [b]Tons more levels:[/b] explore new environments as you uncover the secrets of this mysterious facility
[*] [b]An arsenal of destructive weapons:[/b] wield a wide variety of weapons from blasters to rifles to rocket launchers to laser swords
[*] [b]Unlockable skins:[/b] change your appearance by unlocking skins
[*] [b]Arena Mode:[/b] take on the Arena and fight for survival to earn rewards
[*] [b]An updated Speedrun Mode:[/b] hone your skills even further and conquer time entirely
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34833116/2a946191db7d9813520bd2b41f760f269432cff2.gif[/img]

Please wishlist the game to be notified when it releases! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: ChronoBreach Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
[b]I have released Version 1.1 of ChronoBreach.[/b]

The changes are:
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Adjusted player movement physics (more deceleration)
[/list]

The adjustments in player movement make the game's controls feel a lot better. It no longer feels as slippery. Thank you for all of the feedback I have received; I hope that this update makes the game more enjoyable to play.
